paper_title: Wenn mehr gearbeitet würde – Potenziale des deutschen Arbeitsmarktes
caption: Erwerbstätigenquote von Frauen mit Migrationshintergrund
model_annotation: The diagram compares the employment rates of women with different migration backgrounds across various age groups. The x-axis represents age, ranging from 20 to 70 in intervals of one, while the y-axis represents the percentage of employed women, ranging from 0 to 100 in intervals of 20. Four lines are plotted on the graph, each representing a different category: "ohne Migrationshintergrund" (black, solid line), "in Deutschland geboren" (gray, solid line), "zugewandert bis 2009" (light blue, solid line), and "zugewandert seit 2010" (blue, solid line). The black line starts at around 60% at age 20 and increases to above 80% between ages 25 and 55, before declining sharply to near 0% by age 68. The gray line begins at approximately 40% at age 20, rises to around 80% between ages 30 and 55, and then drops to 0% by age 68. The light blue line commences at about 35% at age 20, fluctuates between 50% and 75% up to age 55, and then decreases to 0% by age 68. The blue line starts at around 35% at age 20, remains relatively stable between 40% and 60% until age 55, and then falls to 0% by age 68.
